dish.title: Japanese Hambagu: Beef and Pork Hamburg Steaks with Rich Pan Sauce
dish.description: Tender, juicy Japanese-style hamburg steaks of ground beef and pork with sauteed onion, milk-soaked panko, and egg, seared and steamed until plump, then glazed in a pan sauce of red wine, ketchup, soy sauce, and butter. Served with rice and a shredded cabbage salad.

recipe_version.title: Japanese Hambagu: Beef and Pork Hamburg Steaks with Rich Pan Sauce
recipe_version.description: Tender, juicy Japanese-style hamburg steaks of ground beef and pork with sauteed onion, milk-soaked panko, and egg, seared and steamed until plump, then glazed in a pan sauce of red wine, ketchup, soy sauce, and butter. Served with rice and a shredded cabbage salad.

ingredients.name: panko breadcrumbs
ingredients.display_name: panko breadcrumbs whose label lists wheat flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and oil only

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp onion, 1 tbsp patties, 1 tbsp salad

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Mince the onion. Soak the panko in the milk.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; rest covered 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in an 8-inch skillet over medium and cook the onion until soft and light golden, about 6 minutes. Spread it on a plate to cool.

steps.title: Shred the salad
steps.body: While the onion cools, finely shred the cabbage and cut the carrot into fine matchsticks; toss with the rice vinegar, 1 tbsp oil, and 1/4 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Shape the patties
steps.body: Knead the beef, pork, cooled onion, soaked panko, egg, nutmeg, 1 tsp salt, and the pepper by hand until sticky, about 2 minutes. Shape into 4 oval patties about 3/4 inch thick, tossing each between your palms to press out air, and press a shallow dent in the center.

steps.title: Sear and steam
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Sear the patties until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Add 1/4 cup water, cover, and steam over medium-low until 160 F at the center, about 7 minutes. Transfer to plates.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Pour off excess fat. Add the wine to the skillet and simmer, scraping, 1 minute; stir in the ketchup, soy sauce, and sugar and simmer until glossy, about 2 minutes. Swirl in the butter off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the sauce over the patties and serve with rice and the cabbage salad.
